cases.name: setup apply run with legs the CLI cannot finish
cases.provenance: HANDLER-LEVEL (plan D open item 5, ratified by R12): the real `setupRun` handler over fully virtual seams, then buildSuccessEnvelope + renderEnvelope — emitSuccess's own composition. `run()` cannot drive it: installFs / argv1 / pid are not RunOverrides members, so a shell run would write to a real HOME and put the test-runner binary path and a live pid in the bytes.
